name: Dolphin
summary: Contributions come from humans, not AI agents. Non-trivial AI-generated parts must be disclosed, and LLMs may not be used for anything about the emulated console's behaviour, since models may contain leaked Nintendo information.

evidence.quote: We accept contributions from humans, not from AI agents. We expect you to understand and take responsibility for code submitted in your name.
If a non-trivial part of your contribution is generated using AI, you need to disclose which parts are generated.
Therefore, you're not allowed to use LLMs to make changes related to the behavior of the emulated console or to use LLMs to obtain information related to the console.
